title: Validate compatibility migration, wheel matrix, rollout, and rollback

authority.statement: Release-candidate qualification proves supported legacy VFS/bucket/WAL/ARC/GraphRAG/replica state migrates idempotently with preserved content, version, and policy semantics; unsupported state fails before mutation with backup and recovery instructions; minimal core and every optional extra project onto the supported Python matrix; staged rollback restores an executable prior state or documents forward recovery without acknowledged loss; the backend support manifest and matrix docs match the live BackendSpec registry; and no required dependency lane skip or stale foreign receipt can satisfy this candidate.

rollback.rehearsal: backup → migrate → verify digests → restore backup → forward re-migrate; WAL crash at after_effect compensated; second recover is no-op

wheel_matrix.notes: Hermetic CI validates packaging projection and core import on the running matrix member; multi-interpreter wheel builds are operator lanes bound to the same requires-python and extra names.

evidence_subset.schema_data_migration: migrate_legacy_bucket_registry and ARC persist/restore preserve content/version/policy; GraphRAG restart/rebuild preserve projection identity
evidence_subset.old_fixtures: Hermetic legacy bucket registry v1, legacy replication policy, legacy WAL status tokens
evidence_subset.wal_replay: WALTransactionCoordinator crash at after_effect; recover compensates; second recover is no-op
evidence_subset.cache_discard: ARC unsupported schema version restore misses without mutating resident entries
evidence_subset.policy_migration: migrate_legacy_replication_policy preserves supported replica counts/backends; geo_distribution fails closed
evidence_subset.minimal_extras_wheels: Core dependencies ≡ requirements.txt; every optional extra non-empty; graphrag and mcp extras exact
evidence_subset.rollback: File-level prior-state restore and documented forward recovery without acknowledged loss

invariants.supported_migration_idempotent: Second migrate of supported bucket registry equals first; WAL projection stable
invariants.content_version_policy_preserved: Registry policy/content_version, ARC binding dimensions, GraphRAG version_id retained
invariants.unsupported_before_mutation: Missing backend, conflicting aliases, non-expressible replica fields raise before publish
invariants.backup_recovery_instructions: Operator doc and receipt carry the five-step backup/recovery procedure
invariants.wheel_matrix_closed: Supported Python versions from classifiers; extras from pyproject only
invariants.rollback_or_forward_recovery: Prior digest restored from backup; forward re-migration matches post-migration digest
invariants.no_acknowledged_loss: Committed effects retained; incomplete WAL effects compensated
invariants.manifest_matches_registry: Manifest names == ACTIVE ∪ EXCLUDED; matrix doc lists every canonical name
invariants.no_required_lane_skips: All dependency lane evidence files present and non-empty
invariants.stale_receipt_rejected: Foreign task receipts and mismatched semantic digests cannot satisfy KITA-046
